appln_title: Wind power boosting-power generation device and method
appln_abstract: The invention discloses a wind power boosting-power generation device and method. The wind power boosting-power generation device comprises a base and a device body, wherein the upper end of the baseis provided with a bearing component and motors; the bearing pedestal of the bearing component is positioned on the upper end of the base, and the main body of the bearing pedestal is a bearing bracket; the motors are positioned on the upper end of the base and are connected with a transmission gear; each transmission gear is meshed with the rack arranged on the upper end of the bearing bracket; the device body and a rack are fixedly connected; under a wind power boosting mode, the device body is provided with a rolling sail structure, the motors harmoniously drive the transmission gears and the rack to rotate so as to drive the drive body to rotate, so that the rolling sail rotates to generate boosting power for ships; and under a power generation mode, the device body is provided with awind turbine blade, the wind turbine blade rotates under an external wind force function, and the rack and the transmission gears are driven to rotate for driving the motor to rotate to generate power. The device is suitable for the ship to utilize wind energy under different navigation states, and wind energy utilization efficiency is greatly improved.

appln_title: QUANTUM COMPUTER SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR OPERATING A MOVABLE QUANTUM COMPUTER
appln_abstract: The invention relates to a quantum computer system comprising a movable quantum computer and a power supply means for at least partially supplying the quantum computer with power. The quantum computer system is characterised in that the power supply means is designed to be moveable and in that the power supply means has a first voltage regulation stage and a second voltage regulation stage and is configured to regulate a power provided by an power source by means of multi-stage voltage regulation using the first voltage regulation stage and the second voltage stage in order to at least partially power the quantum computer to a specified voltage value.

appln_title: Systems and methods for post-quantum cryptography on a smartcard
appln_abstract: Systems, apparatuses, methods, and computer program products are disclosed for post-quantum cryptography (PQC). An example system includes a PQC smartcard. The smartcard may include a PQC cryptographic algorithm selection circuitry configured to select a PQC cryptographic technique from a set of PQC cryptographic techniques for encrypting the data. The smartcard may further include a PQC cryptographic circuitry configured to encrypt data based on a generated set of PQC encryption attributes and the PQC cryptographic technique.

appln_title: Adjustable platform for mounting parts of wind turbine generator
appln_abstract: The utility model discloses an adjustable platform for installing parts of a wind turbine generator, which relates to the technical field of adjusting platforms and comprises an operating platform, and an adjusting buffer mechanism is arranged at the bottom of the operating platform. A positioning dust removal mechanism is arranged at the top of the operation table, a telescopic column is movably connected with a hydraulic column and a rubber pad through an internal threaded connecting rod, the hydraulic column is movably connected with an adjusting rod through a spring in the threaded connecting rod, a connecting rod is installed on the rear face of a driving motor in a threaded mode, and a dust collection box is fixedly installed on the left side face of a dust collection protection plate. A positioning clamping plate is installed on the left side face of the buffering connecting rod in a threaded mode and electrically connected with the distance sensor through the buffering connecting rod. According to the adjustable platform for installing the parts of the wind turbine generator, the hydraulic columns, the springs, the buffer rods, the rotatable dust suction openings and the positioning clamping plates are arranged, so that the height of the platform can be conveniently adjusted, and meanwhile the positioning, guiding and dust removing effects are achieved.

appln_title: Fahrzeug mit einem verlegbaren Quantencomputer und zugehöriges, verlegbares Quantencomputersystem
appln_abstract: Die Erfindung betrifft einen verlegbaren Quantencomputer QC und ein verlegbares Quantencomputersystem QUSYS sowie dessen Anwendungen, insbesondere in tragbaren Geräten und Fahrzeugen. Im Gegensatz zu Vorrichtungen aus dem Stand der Technik weist der Quantencomputer QC und damit das Quantencomputersystem QUSYS Mittel auf, um zum Ersten einen mobilen Betrieb zu ermöglichen und zum Zweiten Störungen durch den mobilen Betrieb auf den Quantencomputer QC und damit das Quantencomputersystem QUSYS zu vermindern.

appln_title: Optimizing method of mixed energy accumulation capacity configuration for stabilization wind power fluctuation
appln_abstract: The invention discloses an optimizing method of mixed energy accumulation capacity configuration for stabilization wind power fluctuation; the method comprises the following steps: generating a coordination control strategy, using a fuzzy control theory for generating a correction adjustment coefficient Kc with SOE1(t-1) and Delta SOE1(t) based on a distribution reference power of a state of energy SOE1(t-1) constraint empirical mode decomposition of power type energy accumulation under a time domain, distributing the actual output power of the mixed energy accumulation; establishing an economy model using the mixed energy accumulation cost as a target function and constraint conditions of the model; using genetic algorithm with chaotic disturbance and quantum computation for optimizing the configuration scheme of the mixed energy accumulation system based on the established economy model and the constraint conditions of the model. The disclosed optimizing method of mixed energy accumulation capacity configuration for stabilization wind power fluctuation is able to achieve the protection to the power type energy accumulation by the coordination control; and the method has the advantages of high in optimization precision, fast in optimization process calculation, and wide in application range.

appln_title: Quanten-Computer-Stack für einen NV-Zentren basierenden Quantencomputer und PQC-Kommunikation von Quantencomputern
appln_abstract: Das hier vorgelegte Dokument beschreibt erstmalig einen mobilen, verlegbaren avionikfähigen Quantencomputer QC der Quantenpunkte NV1, NV2, NV3 auf Basis von NV-Zentren in Diamant umfasst und und/oder Kernquantenpunkte CI12, CI13, CI21, CI22, CI23, CI31, CI32, CI33. auf Basis von13C-Isotopen und14N-Isotopen und15N-Isotopen umfasst. Das Dokument beschreibt die PQC sichere Einbindung eines Solchen Quantencomputers mittels dieses SW-Stacks in ein PQC-sicheres Quantencomputersystem QUSYS.

appln_title: COMPRESSED AIR ENERGY STORAGE POWER GENERATION DEVICE
appln_abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a compressed air energy storage power generation device capable of achieving miniaturization and cost-cutting by reducing the number of compressors and expanders to be installed.SOLUTION: A compressed air energy storage power generation device 2 comprises: a plurality of compressors 6; a pressure accumulation tank 8; and a plurality of expanders 10. The compressors 6 are driven by renewable energy to compress air. The pressure accumulation tank 8 stores the air compressed by the compressors 6. The expanders 10 are driven by compressed air. The expanders 10 are mechanically connected to generators 22 which generate power to be supplied to a consumer. The compressed air energy storage power generation device 2 also has: first heat exchangers 14; a heat storage tank 16 which stores a heat medium; and second heat exchangers 18. The first heat exchangers 14 recovers compression heat and transfers the same to the heat medium. The second heat exchanger 18 heats the compressed air before the same is expanded. In addition, the compressed air energy storage power generation device 2 is provided with: a combined compression and expansion machine 28 which has functions of both compressor 6 and expander 10; and a control device 36 to switch the functions between compression and expansion.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

appln_title: Systems and methods for post-quantum cryptography optimization
appln_abstract: Systems, apparatuses, methods, and computer program products are disclosed for gathering performance information for post-quantum cryptography (PQC) is provided. An example method includes generating, by a QC detection data generation circuitry, QC detection data. The example method further includes encrypting, by a PQC cryptographic circuitry, the QC detection data based on a PQC cryptographic technique The example method further includes decrypting, by a PQC decryption circuitry, the QC detection data. The example method further includes storing, by a PQC cryptographic performance circuitry, encryption metadata generated by the PQC cryptographic circuitry and decryption metadata generated by the PQC decryption circuitry as PQC cryptographic performance information associated with the PQC cryptographic technique.

appln_title: Power transmission line icing thickness prediction method based on CEEMDAN-QFOA-LSTM
appln_abstract: The invention discloses a power transmission line icing thickness prediction method based on CEEMDAN-QFOA-LSTM, and relates to the field of combination of power transmission line state evaluation anddeep learning. The method comprises the following steps o: (1) carrying out data acquisition and preprocessing; (2) carrying out CEEMDAN decomposition on an icing thickness historical data sequence (12); (3) optimizing hyper-parameters of the LSTM by a quantum drosophila melanogaster algorithm; (4) carrying out LSTM model training (14); and (5) predicting the icing thickness of a power transmission line and analyzing a result (15). According to the method, the CEEMDAN decomposition algorithm is used, a sequence which is difficult to directly predict is converted into a plurality of predictablecomponent sequences; a neural network can more accurately grasp the law of the sequence according to multi-dimensional feature information obtained through decomposition; a QFOA optimization algorithm is used for obtaining the hyper-parameters, a complex manual parameter adjustment process is avoided, and a network model is trained more effectively; the used LSTM neural network does not have theproblem of gradient disappearance of a general network, so that optimal convergence of the model is ensured, and the problem of short-term and long-term time sequence prediction is effectively solved.

appln_title: Method and system for estimating the wear of a rotating machine including a bearing
appln_abstract: A method including measuring vibrations of a rotating machine during its operation, using a vibration sensor. Next, from the signal measured by the sensor, automatically extracting, using an electronic detection device, a first signal representative of components of a first frequency range of the measured vibration signal, and a second signal representative of a second frequency range of the measured vibration signal. Then, from the first signal, calculating a first data set belonging to a time domain of the first signal, and extracting first calculation elements therefrom. Next, from the second signal, calculating a second data set belonging to a frequency domain of the second signal, and extracting second calculation elements therefrom. Lastly, determining a health index of the bearing from each of the extracted calculation elements.

appln_title: Conductive slip ring capable of realizing 360-degree unlimited rotation
appln_abstract: The utility model belongs to the technical field of conductive slip rings, and relates to a 360-degree unlimited rotation conductive slip ring, which comprises a stator assembly, a rotor assembly and an auxiliary contact assembly, the stator assembly comprises a shell, a first conductive ring is fixedly arranged on the inner wall of the shell, the rotor assembly is rotatably arranged in the first conductive ring, and the auxiliary contact assembly is arranged in the shell. The auxiliary contact assembly is fixedly installed on one side of the rotor assembly, the rotor assembly comprises an insulating shaft, a second conducting ring is fixedly installed on the outer side of the insulating shaft and located in the shell, and one end of the insulating shaft extends to the outside of the shell. The conductive grease moves along with the contact ring, so that the conductive grease flows in the shell, the lubricating effect during rotation is improved, through the auxiliary contact assembly, the ball rotates in the annular groove during rotation, the contact effect is improved, and the wire breaking phenomenon is avoided.

appln_title: Cleanable radiator for computer
appln_abstract: The invention provides a cleanable radiator for a computer. The cleanable radiator comprises a hollowed-out non-slip mat, a radiating net, a hollowed-out net plate, a supporting lining base, a movableshaft, a mounting base, a base, a non-slip foot base, a mounting lining base, a concave blocking base, a connecting shaft, a stopping block, a detachable auxiliary radiator convenient to clean, a height auxiliary inclination adjusting frame and a rotary article containing and collecting tank structure. Hollow non-slip mat, the heat dissipation net is hollowed out to form a net plate; the fan blades and the heat dissipation motor are arranged. when a computer is placed, a computer is placed at the upper part of the heat dissipation net through the hollow non-slip mat; at the moment, the concave blocking seat is used for blocking. The computer is electrically connected with the heat dissipation motor through the data line, at the moment, the heat dissipation motor continuously drives the fan blades to rotate, cold air emitted by the detachable cleaning rapid auxiliary cooling fin structure is blown to the computer through the hollow screen plate in the wind direction in a follow-up mode, cooling and heat dissipation work is conducted on the computer, and the heat dissipation capacity is improved.

appln_title: Horizontal axis wind generating set blade and blade shank segment truss structure and manufacturing method
appln_abstract: A horizontal axis wind generating set blade and blade shank segment truss structure is mainly composed of a tube structure body located at the center of a blade shank and diagonal bars located outside the blade shank. A tube structure is a quadrangular barrel or a cylindrical barrel with a revolution surface, and the barrel can be a tapered barrel. The outside diagonal bars directionally bear partial load and provide proper structure stability. The blade shank segment truss structure is concise and practical, and specified functions are realized. Meanwhile, the invention discloses a method of forming the barrel by the fiber composite material pultrusion technology, flexibility feature of a cross section of a thin-walled shell with uniform cross section is directly utilized, and variable cross-section contour requirements of the barrel can be realized by restraint of an end forming flange. Longitudinal reinforcing ribs provide longitudinal strength and rigidity of the barrel without affecting deformation of a cross-section contour of the barrel.

appln_title: CLAMPING DEVICE
appln_abstract: A clamping device for handling a wind turbine blade is disclosed. The clamping device comprises attachment means (8, 8', 8', 8'') configured to detachably attach the clamping device (2) to a wind turbine blade (50). The clamping device (2) is configured to be opened and closed. The clamping device (2) comprises one or more insert members (8, 8' 8', 8'') that fit the outer geometry of the wind turbine blade (50). The insert members (8, 8', 8', 8'') constitute a space (10) with an interlocking geometric shape configured to prevent the clamping device (2) from moving when the clamping device (2) is closed and attached to a wind turbine blade (50). The portion of the insert members (8, 8', 8', 8'') that is configured to bear against the wind turbine blade (50) comprises a resilient component (90) having a coefficient of static friction, µs, of such a magnitude that a significant friction force (Ffriction) is provided between the outside surface of the wind turbine blade (50) and the insert members (8, 8', 8', 8'').

appln_title: Vertical coreless permanent magnet wind driven generator
appln_abstract: The invention relates to a vertical coreless permanent magnet wind driven generator. The vertical coreless permanent magnet wind driven generator comprises a stator, a rotor, a shell, a rotating shaftand a plurality of blades, wherein whirl wings are arranged between the rotating shaft and the plurality of blades, and are correspondingly arranged at the two ends of the rotating shaft; the bladesare rotatably connected with the rotating shaft through the whirl wings; the bottom end of the rotating shaft is rotatably connected with the shell; the shell is fixedly connected with the whirl wings; the rotor is arranged in the shell, and the rotor comprises a magnetic yoke and a plurality of permanent magnets; the magnetic yoke comprises an upper magnetic yoke and a lower magnetic yoke; the stator is arranged between the upper magnetic yoke and the lower magnetic yoke, and the stator is a winding disc which is of an annular structure; a winding is embedded in the winding disc; and the winding disc is fixedly connected with the rotating shaft. According to the vertical coreless permanent magnet wind driven generator, the structure of the motor is optimized, so that each part is mutuallyindependent and convenient to produce, install and maintain.

appln_title: Blade deicing device for wind driven generator
appln_abstract: The invention discloses a blade deicing device for a wind driven generator. The blade deicing device for the wind driven generator comprises a power generation mechanism used for power generation, the power generation mechanism is connected with a supporting mechanism, one end of the power generation mechanism is connected with a blade mechanism, the blade mechanism comprises blades, and a heating deicing mechanism is arranged on the inner wall of the blade mechanism, and the inner of the blade mechanism is further provided with a spray mechanism for spraying an deicing agent. According to the blade deicing device, the problem that ice blocks are left on the blades, and use of the blades is affected is solved, and meanwhile deicing can be conducted by spraying the deicing agent.

appln_title: Auxiliary supporting device for tunnel investigation
appln_abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of supporting equipment for exploration, in particular to an auxiliary supporting device for tunnel exploration. According to the auxiliary supporting device for tunnel exploration, a storage structure for equipment is additionally arranged, the phenomenon that exploration personnel are overtired is reduced, and the use convenience of the equipment is improved. Comprising a supporting plate and three sets of supporting frames arranged at the bottom end of the supporting plate, the top ends of the three sets of supporting frames are rotationally connected with the outer side wall of the bottom end of the supporting plate, each supporting frame comprises a first frame body, a second frame body and a third frame body, and the first frame bodies, the second frame bodies and the third frame bodies are connected through fixing devices; a cavity is formed in the storage box, the supporting plate and the three sets of supporting frames are all arranged in the cavity, a through opening is formed in the top end of the storage box, the through opening communicates with the top end of the cavity, and a blocking cover is arranged in the through opening; and the three groups of universal wheels are fixedly arranged in the storage box.

appln_title: 380V uses power spare power automatic switching system in station
appln_abstract: The utility model discloses a 380V uses power spare power automatic switching system in station, including the robot main part, robot main part front side is provided with the cloud platform, and high definition digtal camera and infrared thermal imager are installed to the cloud bench, and high definition digtal camera and infrared thermal imager are connected to the robot control ware, and the robot control ware is connected to monitor terminal through wireless wiFi module, and monitor terminal is connected with temperature alarm device. The utility model discloses a high definition digtal camera and infrared thermal imager realize the temperature monitoring in the transformer substation, realize that the transformer substation monitors fully, the monitoring data is more accurate reliable, when the temperature is greater than the settlement threshold value, automatically, remind through temperature alarm device, operation Terminal in time makes the source reason, steady operation and the operational reliability and the security of transformer substation improve greatly, install with the cloud bench, that both can guarantee two cameras supervision is same device location, be convenient for in time the judge concrete hot spot of equipment, judge and take corresponding measure to strive for the valuable time for the accuracy.

appln_title: Rotor protection device
appln_abstract: A rotor protection device comprises a rotor positioning plate and a rotor turnover vehicle used for installing the rotor positioning plate. A plurality of trays are arranged on the rotor turnover vehicle, and the rotor positioning plates are installed on the trays in a matched mode. A spring device is also arranged on the rotor turnover vehicle; the sizes of the rotor turnover vehicle and the rotor positioning plate are reasonably designed, so that workers can conveniently take and place rotors, and the excessive strain of the workers during frequent taking and placing is reduced; and the distribution and arrangement mode of the round holes in the rotor positioning plate is reasonably designed, so that more rotors can be turned over at a time, the working efficiency is effectively improved, and the condition that the rotors collide with one another and are damaged during turning over is effectively avoided.

appln_title: AI-BASED ENERGY EDGE PLATFORM, SYSTEMS, AND METHODS
appln_abstract: An Al-based energy edge platform is provided herein with a wide range of features, components and capabilities for management and improvement of legacy infrastructure and coordination with distributed systems to support important use cases for a range of enterprises. The platform may incorporate emerging technologies to enable ecosystem and individual energy edge node efficiencies, agility, engagement, and profitability. Embodiments may forecast, plan for, and manage the demand and utilization of energy in greater distributed environments. Embodiments may use Al, loT, and technologies that filter, process, and move data more effectively across communication networks. Embodiments of the platform may leverage energy market connection, communication, and transaction enablement platforms. Embodiments may employ intelligent provisioning, data aggregation, and analytics.

appln_title: Highway bridge construction fence
appln_abstract: The highway bridge construction fence comprises a base, a mounting groove is formed in the upper surface of the base, a fence frame is fixedly connected to the inner bottom wall of the mounting groove, a fence plate is slidably connected to the inner wall of the fence frame, and a windproof assembly is fixedly connected to the front face of the fence plate. According to the wind-proof fence, the fan blades rotate under the influence of external wind power, the driving part and the supporting part are interlocked to operate, the driving part is used for enabling the wind-proof plate to form a radian and reducing the influence of the wind power on the fence, the supporting part is used for supporting the fence when the wind power is too large, and meanwhile through the bulged wind-proof plate, a third spring and a rubber block, the wind-proof fence can be prevented from falling off. And damage to the fence during toppling is reduced, so that the highway bridge construction fence solves the problems that the fence is prone to toppling due to the influence of external wind, and potential safety hazards exist.

appln_title: Fahrzeug mit einem verlegbaren Quantencomputer und zugehöriges, verlegbares Quantencomputersystem mit Schutz vor transienten Störungen der Energieversorgung
appln_abstract: Die Erfindung betrifft einen verlegbaren Quantencomputer QC und ein verlegbares Quantencomputersystem QUSYS sowie dessen Anwendungen, insbesondere in tragbaren Geräten und Fahrzeugen. Im Gegensatz zu Vorrichtungen aus dem Stand der Technik weist der Quantencomputer QC und damit das Quantencomputersystem QUSYS Mittel auf, um zum Ersten einen mobilen Betrieb zu ermöglichen und zum Zweiten Störungen durch den mobilen Betrieb auf den Quantencomputer QC und damit das Quantencomputersystem QUSYS zu vermindern.

appln_title: Textile auxiliary powder mixer with cleaning and drying functions
appln_abstract: The utility model discloses a textile auxiliary powder mixer with cleaning and drying functions, which comprises a mixing drum, telescopic mechanisms are mounted at two ends of the left side of the mixing drum, two ends of one side of a sliding rod are fixedly connected with output ends of the corresponding telescopic mechanisms respectively, a gear motor is mounted on the other side of the sliding rod, and an output end of the gear motor is connected with a rotating shaft. The rotating shaft penetrates through the top end of the mixing barrel and extends into the mixing barrel, the part, located in the mixing barrel, of the rotating shaft is fixedly connected with a plurality of stirring rods, the stirring rods are fixedly connected with a plurality of stirring stand columns, the bottom end of the rotating shaft is fixedly connected with a fixing block, and the two sides of the fixing block are fixedly connected with stirring assemblies which are symmetrically arranged. According to the utility model, powder can be rotated and vertically moved and stirred in the mixing cylinder, the mixing effect is outstanding, the mixing cylinder can be cleaned and quickly dried after being cleaned, the long waiting time of a user after cleaning is avoided, the time is saved, and the use of the user is facilitated.

appln_title: Renewable energy power generation system stability quantitative analysis method
appln_abstract: The invention discloses a renewable energy power generation system stability quantitative analysis method in the technical field of power system and automation. The method comprises the following steps: extracting amplitude-phase equivalent parameters to characterize dynamic characteristics of each renewable energy power generation subsystem; deeply mining parameter information to reflect interaction characteristics of stability between subsystems; and carrying out equivalent aggregation on the amplitude-phase equivalent parameters of the subsystems, and carrying out quantification to obtain quantitative index of stability of an original renewable energy power generation system. The method can extract the stability quantitative information of the renewable energy power generation system, fills the technical blank in the field of stability quantitative research of a non-synchronous renewable energy power generation system, lays a theoretical foundation for further integrating the renewable energy power generation system dominated by large-scale power electronic equipment into the stable control and optimized decision-making step and realizing precise control, and is of great theoretical and engineering significance.

appln_title: Real-time charging optimization method for electric vehicle cluster based on clustering control
appln_abstract: The invention discloses a real-time charging optimization method for electric vehicle cluster based on clustering control, and relates to the field of real-time charging in electric vehicle cluster, which comprising the following steps of: step 1, based on a distributed layered control framework, performing a queue division on the EV cluster by taking the charging end time as a judgment amount; step 2, according to the charging characteristics of EV cluster, the queue division of EV cluster is conducted by taking the end of charging as a criterion; step 2, a real-time optimization model of charging and discharging power for EV cluster with the objective of minimizing daily load fluctuation is solved, real-time optimization of charging and discharging power of EV cluster is carried out, andsecurity constraints are checked by distribution network; step 3, on the basis of an EV cluster scheduling result, the charging and discharging costs of EV owners are considered, a power allocation model in EV cluster is solved, the optimal power allocation for charging and discharging power of a single EV in the EV cluster is obtained, so that the total output of the EV cluster is as close as possible to the scheduling result. By means of the device, EV charge and discharge distributed layered control framework is adopted, thereby realizing the real-time control of charging and discharging in EV cluster.

appln_title: Multifunctional operating element
appln_abstract: The invention refers to a knob-shaped multifunctional operating element (1), the periphery of which can be enclosed in order to manually control a computer device of an electrical device especially a motor by one hand. The multifunctional operating element (1) possesses at least two surrounding elements (2,3) which can are separated with each other and can obtain support in a rotation way. A corresponding outer side (7) of the surrounding elements (2,3) can only touch in a limited way and provide a rotation acting plane (16) for single hand control in a corresponding touch area, wherein the rotation acting plane (16) is especially arranged in different regions of the periphery of the multifunctional operating element (1) in a radial opposed way.

appln_title: Porous-based ultrasonic-speed adsorption type compressor blade
appln_abstract: The invention discloses a porous-based ultrasonic-speed adsorption type compressor blade. A suction chamber which is through in a blade extending direction is arranged between a suction surface and a pressure surface of the ultrasonic-speed adsorption type compressor blade. A plurality of suction holes which communicate with the suction chamber are distributed in the suction surface of the ultrasonic-speed adsorption type compressor blade. Each suction hole is a circular hole or a rectangular hole with the same cross section area. Blade spacing on a gate plate, of the ultrasonic-speed adsorption type compressor blade is 30.55 mm, and a mounting angle is 47 degrees; during numerical simulation under a designed working condition, an inlet gas flow angle is 61 degrees, and an inlet Mach number is 1.5. The porous-based ultrasonic-speed adsorption type compressor blade avoids reflection, on the suction force, of shock waves, reduces loss of passing shock waves; and meanwhile, shock wave impact points are in the suction holes, so that mutual interference between the shock waves and the attaching layer of the suction force are effectively weakened, an attaching layer separation phenomenon after shock waves is effectively inhibited, too great Mach after before shock waves due to continuous acceleration, on the suction force, of the gas flow is avoided, and Mach number before waves and shock wave loss are reduced.

appln_title: REDUCING CURTAILMENT OF WIND POWER GENERATION
appln_abstract: Historical electrical power output measurements of a wind turbine for a time period immediately preceding a specified past time are received. Historical wind speed micro-forecasts for the geographic location of the wind turbine, for a time period immediately preceding the specified past time and for a time period immediately following the specified past time are received. Based on the historical electrical power output measurements and the historical wind speed micro-forecasts, a trained machine learning model for predicting wind power output of the wind turbine is generated. Real-time electrical power output measurements of the wind turbine and real-time wind speed micro-forecasts for the geographic location of the wind turbine are received. Using the trained machine learning model with the real-time electrical power output measurements of the wind turbine and the real-time wind speed micro-forecasts, a wind power output forecast for the wind turbine at a future time is outputted.

appln_title: Apparatus for removing fine dust using vortex tube and air purification system using thereof
appln_abstract: The present invention relates to an apparatus and a method for removing fine dust in the air. According to the present invention, in order to solve problems of a conventional apparatus for removing fine dust and an air purifying device, including cost increases and inconvenience caused by frequent filter replacement resulting from configuration of using a filter or spraying water, complexity of entire configuration of the apparatus, and a drawback of high energy consumption, a principle of a vortex tube is used, thereby producing nano-bubbles of water particles along with external air injected into the vortex tube such that a contact time and a contact area are maximized when both of the nano-bubbles of water particles and the external air pass through the inside of the vortex tube to allow effective removal of fine dust. Provided are an apparatus for removing fine dust using a vortex tube and an air purifying system using the same, configured to enhance effects of fine dust and air purification at simple configuration and at inexpensive costs without needs of separate power. The present invention comprises a water storage unit, an air purification unit, and a pump unit.

appln_title: Bicycle steering lamp equipment based on wind energy during driving
appln_abstract: The invention discloses bicycle steering lamp equipment based on wind energy during driving. The equipment comprises a box body, and a trapezoidal cavity which is through up and down is formed in thebox body; a triggering mechanism is arranged in the trapezoidal cavity; the triggering mechanism comprises a trapezoidal sliding block; and an annular iron block is fixedly arranged on the end face ofthe lower side of the trapezoidal sliding block. A front wheel axle is arranged below the annular iron block; and magnet blocks are symmetrically and fixedly arranged on the front side and the rear side of the front wheel shaft. According to the wind power generation bicycle, a steering prompt can be sent to surrounding people or vehicles under the condition that no extra operation of a bicycle rider is needed, wind is inevitably generated when the bicycle passes through the bicycle, and the wind power generation bicycle is green equipment based on wind power generation.

appln_title: Large scale disc-type multi-stator permanent magnet direct-drive wind power generator
appln_abstract: The present invention is a large scale disc-type multi-stator permanent magnet direct-drive wind power generator which mainly comprises a hub (1), a rotor shaft (5), a stationary shaft (11), a bracket (16) and a plurality of generator units, wherein: the stationary shaft (11) is fixed to the bracket (16); the rotor shaft (5) is fixed to the hub (1) and is rotatably mounted on the stationary shaft (11); each of the generator units comprises a disc-type winding (10) and permanent magnets (6) disposed on two sides of the disc-type winding (10); each of the disc-type windings (10) of the generator units is fixedly connected to the casing (8); each of the disc-type windings (10) comprises a plurality of rectangular spiral windings which are connected in series, and ends of the connected windings are guided via wires to an exterior of the casing to connect in series or in parallel with other disc-type windings; permanent magnets (6) are fixed on the rotor shaft (7) via rotor rotating discs (5). The present invention makes use of a disc-type multi-stator structure which fully utilizes the internal space of the rotors and increases the power density of the generator. It also reduces the longitudinal and axial sizes of the wind generators, and effectively lower generator weight and costs.

appln_title: Adaptive power supply
appln_abstract: A power supply comprises a control unit for adjusting a power output by the power control unit in response to a control signal. The power supply further includes a processing unit configured to generate the control signal using a control model and based at least on one or more sensor signals supplied to the processing unit. The processing unit is configured to communicate via an interface with an external processing entity to receive a data set for generating the control model and/or to receive the control model, and/or to transmit the model to the external processing entity.

appln_title: Wind speed and wind direction measuring method for wind power generation system
appln_abstract: The invention discloses a wind speed and wind direction measuring method used for a wind power generation system, which is applicable to low wind speed zones. The method is characterized in that an anemoscope and a dogvane are installed on a tower under a wind wheel swept surface so as to measure wind speed and wind direction. The method is applicable to the low wind speed wind power generation system with the annual average wind speed ranging from 4m/s to 6m/s, vertical distances from the anemoscope and the dogvane to the wind wheel swept surface are at least 1.5 meters, and the diameter of the tower is twice that of the external edge of the tower. By adopting the method, the accurate measurement of the wind speed and the wind direction under the low wind speed environment can be guaranteed, and the problem that when the anemoscope and the dogvane are installed at the tail part of an engine room, inaccurate measurement of the wind speed and the wind direction can be caused due to the low-speed rotation of the wind wheel, can be avoided.

appln_title: SYSTEM, APPARATUS AND METHOD FOR CLEAN, MULTI-ENERGY GENERATION
appln_abstract: Systems, apparatuses and methods in interoperating with multiple clean energy sources, such as pneumatic energy, electrical energy, hydrogen energy and steam energy, with engine configurations employing theses clean energy sources dynamically and synchronously. Further embodiments including fossil fuel energies.

appln_title: Quantum deep reinforcement learning control method of doubly-fed wind generator
appln_abstract: The invention provides a quantum deep reinforcement learning control method of a doubly-fed wind generator. The method can solve the control problem of stator flux linkage change of the doubly-fed wind generator after a power grid fault is removed and when the power grid voltage is asymmetrically and suddenly increased. The method is a control method combining Bayesian quantum feedback control, deep learning and reinforcement learning. The Bayesian quantum feedback control process is divided into two steps of state estimation and feedback control, and feedback input is historical measurement and current measurement records. Bayesian quantum feedback can effectively control decoherence in solid quantum bits. The deep learning part adopts a convolutional neural network model and a back propagation method. In the reinforcement learning part, Q learning based on a Markov decision process is used as a control framework of the whole method. According to the method, the control stability of the doubly-fed wind generator can be effectively improved, and the wind energy utilization efficiency is improved.

appln_title: Pitch cone angle measurement method and pitch cone angle measurement device
appln_abstract: A pitch cone angle measurement method includes bringing an abutment portion into abutment against ridges, and bringing another abutment portion into abutment against the ridges at a position separated in a direction orthogonal to a rotation axis direction of the rotation power transmitting element by a radial distance from a position at which the ridges and the abutment portion are brought into abutment against each other. The method also includes measuring a distance in the rotation axis direction between the position at which the abutment portion is brought into abutment against the ridges and a position at which the other abutment portion is brought into abutment against the ridges, and calculating a pitch cone angle of the rotation power transmitting element based on the distance in the rotation axis direction and the predetermined radial distance.

appln_title: ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE POST-QUANTUM CRYPTOGRAPHY METHOD AND DEVICE
appln_abstract: The present invention, which is performed by a device, comprises the steps of: generating first ciphertext data by encoding plaintext data on the basis of an encoding key; generating a first signature code and a second signature code by applying a noise vector, which is extracted periodically, to a deep learning-based generation model; and generating second ciphertext data by applying the first signature code and the second signature code to the first ciphertext data. In the step of generating the first signature code, type and replacement location of character required for generating the first signature code are determined by means of a predetermined conversion formula, and an existing encoding character existing in the replacement location in the first ciphertext data and a first character calculated from the character by means of a predetermined scheme are generated as the first signature code. In the step of generating the second signature code, type and insertion location of second character to be used as the second signature code are determined by means of the conversion formula. In the step of generating the second ciphertext data, the second ciphertext data may be generated by replacing the existing encoding character existing in the replacement location in the first ciphertext data with the first character, and inserting the second character to the insertion location in the first ciphertext data.

appln_title: Photovoltaic systems with intermittent and continuous recycling of light
appln_abstract: Photovoltaic systems and methods for optimizing the harvesting of solar energy are disclosed. A photovoltaic (PV) system includes: a solar panel module. The solar panel module comprises: a plurality of solar cell arrays, wherein each array comprises a grouping of solar cells; and a tubular panel. The plurality of solar cell arrays are arranged along an inside surface of the panel. At least an upper portion of the panel slopes inward such that the panel has a substantially funnel-shaped geometry. The solar cell arrays are arranged in a C-ring pattern. A first solar cell array is separated from a second solar cell array by a predetermined distance. The area between the solar cell arrays is coated with a reflective material to facilitate optimal reflection of incident sunlight back to the solar cells. Recycling of incident light is facilitated within the tube. The light can be intermittently or continuously recycled.

appln_title: Construction spreading foundation adaptive to filled ground settlement and construction method
appln_abstract: The invention discloses a construction spreading foundation adaptive to a filled ground settlement and a construction method. The construction spreading foundation comprises an overhanging structure on the upper portion of a pillar foundation, the pillar foundation, a construction spreading foundation body, a cushion block layer and a basement cushion layer. The method for heightening the settled construction spreading foundation includes the following steps: 1) excavating filling until to the basement cushion layer; 2) horizontally arranging an ejecting beam under the overhanging structure on the upper portion of the pillar foundation; 3) placing jacks under the portions close to two ends of the ejecting beam; 4) ejecting the ejecting beam through the jacks; 5) filling cushion blocks between the construction spreading foundation body and the basement cushion layer under the construction spreading foundation body; and 6) finally, demounting the jacks and the ejecting beam, and placing the filling back. The construction spreading foundation is reasonable in structure, convenient to construct, safe and reliable, can effectively avoid bad influence to foundation construction and normal use of architectural structures caused by foundation settlement, and has good economic benefit and time benefit in engineering construction, and the height of the foundation can be adjusted at any time according to requirements.

appln_title: Subway vehicle bogie multi-component preventive maintenance decision optimization model
appln_abstract: The invention discloses a subway vehicle bogie multi-component preventive maintenance decision optimization model. According to the model, the fault probability of multiple components in a bogie is monitored by adopting a reliability-based state-opportunity maintenance mode optimization model, a mathematical model is established for the fault rate of repairable components, and parameters of the mathematical model are estimated; a mathematical model taking the lowest daily average maintenance cost of the repairable components as an objective function is established; the mathematical model of the target function is optimized by adopting an intelligent algorithm to search an optimal value, and a reliability threshold of the repairable components is solved by utilizing correlation between decision variables; a Monte Carlo simulation train multi-component maintenance strategy is adopted, and the maintenance mode, the maintenance number, the maintenance time and the maintenance cost of eachtrain component are obtained and recorded. The model can improve the utilization rate of the train on the basis of meeting the operation reliability of train components, reduces the maintenance cost,and reference and theoretical support is provided for the optimization research of a subway train maintenance model.

appln_title: Updating weight values in a machine learning system
appln_abstract: A machine learning system includes a learning section and an operating section including a memory. The operating section holds a required accuracy, and an internal state and a weight value of a learner in the memory and executes calculation processing by using data input to the machine learning system and the weight value held in the memory to update the internal state. An accuracy of the internal state is calculated from a result of the calculation processing and an evaluation value is calculated using the data input to the machine learning system, the weight value, and the updated internal state held in the memory when the calculated accuracy is higher than the required accuracy. The evaluation value is transmitted to the learning section, which updates the weight value by using the evaluation value and notifies the number of times of updating the weight value to the operating section.

appln_title: High-rise fire escape slideway hoisting method and device
appln_abstract: The invention discloses a high-rise fire escape slideway hoisting method which comprises the following steps: 1), a minitype RC helicopter carries a throwing thing to lift off until to be above the height of a floor where a trapped person is positioned; 2), the minitype RC helicopter releases the throwing thing, and the throwing thing is fixed at the position above the height of the floor where the trapped person is positioned; 3), a bearing line is led to the position above the height of the floor where the trapped person is positioned through a leading line; and 4), an escape slideway is led to the position of the floor where the trapped person is positioned through the bearing line. The invention further discloses a high-rise fire escape slideway hoisting device which comprises the minitype RC helicopter carried with the throwing thing which is connected with the leading line, the leading line is vertical to the ground and is connected with one end of the bearing line, and the other end of the bearing line is connected with the escape slideway. A device provided by the invention has the advantages of low cost, quickness in scheduling, small occupied space, high rescue efficiency, and strong operability.

appln_title: Microgrid power supply double-layer optimal configuration method
appln_abstract: The invention discloses a microgrid power supply double-layer optimal configuration method, which relates to the technical field of microgrids, in particular to a microgrid power supply double-layer optimal configuration method, which comprises the steps of S1, establishing a microgrid power supply model including a wind driven generator model, a photovoltaic array model and an energy storage model, S2, establishing a microgrid power supply optimal configuration model, and S3, adopting an HQGA algorithm for microgrid power supply optimal configuration. According to the microgrid power supply double-layer optimal configuration method, the adaptive rotation angle adjustment strategy, the quantum bit crossover mutation operation and the group catastrophe thought are utilized to optimize the configuration of the microgrid power supply, the advantages of the microgrid can be utilized more reasonably to achieve the purpose of reasonable utilization of resources, the convergence speed is high, and moreover, an optimal scheme can be searched from the global perspective, and meanwhile errors are ensured to be small.

appln_title: METHODS AND CONTROL SYSTEMS FOR VOLTAGE CONTROL OF RENEWABLE ENERGY GENERATORS
appln_abstract: Aspects of the present invention relate to a method (100) for controlling a renewable energy generator (14). The method (100) comprises: receiving (102) a signal from a power plant controller (22) indicating a reactive power setpoint; determining (104) reactive power limits for the generator (14); generating (106) a control signal for the renewable energy generator (14), the control signal being based on the reactive power setpoint and limited based on the determined reactive power limits; and controlling (108) the generator (14) according to the control signal. Determining (104) the reactive power limits comprises: determining (110) a generator limit corresponding to the reactive power capability of the generator (14); determining (112) a terminal voltage of the generator (14); comparing (114) the determined terminal voltage to a voltage limit: determining (116) a voltage-based limit based on the comparison.

appln_title: Rolling bearing fault diagnosis method for optimizing support vector machine through quantum differential evolution algorithm
appln_abstract: The invention relates to a rolling bearing fault diagnosis method for optimizing a support vector machine through a quantum differential evolution algorithm. The method comprises the steps of inputting an input feature matrix P of a rolling bearing to be subjected to fault diagnosis into a fault diagnosis model, obtaining a one-dimensional column vector Q, representing an inner ring fault when 1 appears in the Q, representing a rolling body fault when 2 appears in the Q, representing a 6 o'clock direction fault of the outer ring when 3 appears, representing a 3 o'clock direction fault of the outer ring when 4 appears, representing a 12 o'clock direction fault of the outer ring when 5 appears, and representing normal when 6 appears. According to the method, the support vector machine model is optimized by using the quantum differential evolution algorithm, so that adaptive adjustment of parameters is realized. Compared with a traditional differential evolution algorithm, the quantum differential evolution algorithm has the advantages that when the support vector machine model is optimized, the time needed to be spent can be shortened, the optimization precision is improved, and the model has more reliable fault diagnosis performance.

appln_title: Fan bearing fault diagnosis method based on SFA and CNN
appln_abstract: The invention discloses a fan bearing fault diagnosis method based on Slow Feature Analysis (SFA) and Convolution Neural Network (CNN). The method comprises the steps that firstly, after a bearing vibration signal is collected, the SFA is utilized for extracting therein solid feature information; secondly, a one-dimensional feature signal is converted into two-dimensional image information; thirdly, a training set and a testing set are divided, and the fault type is defined; fourthly, a convolution neural network framework is constructed, and network parameters are initialized; and fifthly, the network is trained, and the testing set is used for checking. Focusing on the application research of the newly-developed deep learning technology in the traditional field, the proposed method can effectively achieve the diagnosis of fan faults.

appln_title: Special tool for motor stator transfer
appln_abstract: The invention discloses a special tool for motor stator transfer. The special tool comprises a paint dipping tool for placing a single motor stator and a lifting tool. The lifting tool comprises a tool body including a lower support plate assembly, a hoisting device at the top, a plurality of vertically arranged support columns, a plurality of limiting blocks and an upper support plate assembly, wherein, a plurality of paint dipping tools can be placed on the upper support plate assembly and the lower support plate assembly for batch transfer of paint-dipped motor stators. The hoisting tool with a cage structure can be arranged and a plurality of paint dipping tools can be directly loaded, thus effectively solving the transferring between paint dipping and drying processes and ensuring production requirements; meanwhile, the tool is divide into upper and lower layers and the upper layer is movable so that batch transferring can be met, the problem of single transferring can be completely solved and the production efficiency is improved; moreover, the overall structure of the tool is a cage structure, the structure is simple, the manufacturing is convenient and the stability is good.

appln_title: Centralized power supply brightening system
appln_abstract: The invention discloses a centralized power supply brightening system which comprises a commercial power supply branch, a clean energy power supply branch, an MOS transistor, an LED lamp string, a pulse dimming circuit and a controller. The commercial power supply branch is connected with the power supply end of the MOS transistor through a switch K2, and the clean energy power supply branch is connected with the power supply end of the MOS transistor through a switch K1. A pulse output circuit outputs pulses to the control end of the MOS transistor. The pulse output circuit is controlled by the controller. The output end of the MOS transistor is connected with the power supply end of the LED lamp string. The commercial power supply branch comprises a transformer and a rectifier, and the primary side of the transformer is connected with 220V commercial power. The clean energy power supply branch comprises a lithium battery, a charging circuit, a converter, a solar panel and a wind turbine. The wind turbine outputs DC power to the charging circuit through the converter. The solar panel is directly connected with the charging circuit, and the charging circuit is used for charging thelithium battery. The centralized power supply brightening system has a high degree of automation and rich functions.

appln_title: Sea wave tunnel power generation device
appln_abstract: The utility model discloses a sea wave tunnel power generation device, which relates to the technical field of power generation, and is characterized in that a gas collection arc with a C-shaped cross section is arranged on one side, facing the sea, of a coast, a tunnel is arranged on the coast, one end of the tunnel is positioned at the middle lower part of the gas collection arc, and the other side of the tunnel obliquely extends upwards and then is communicated with one end of a ground air duct. And the ground air duct is fixedly arranged on the coast. The other end of the ground air duct communicates with the bottom of the wind tower. The advantages of tides, sea wind, sea waves and a wind tower are ingeniously and organically combined, utilization of natural resources can be improved, and the wind power generation efficiency can be improved.

appln_title: Energy storage grid-connected circuit based on lithium batteries and super capacitor and control method thereof
appln_abstract: The invention discloses an energy storage grid-connected circuit based on lithium batteries and a super capacitor and a control method thereof in the technical field of power equipment design, which is used for solving the problems that the electric power quality, the reverse current, the power random fluctuation and the like of a power grid are influenced by the grid connection of a distributed power supply. The energy storage grid-connected circuit comprises a lithium battery pack, a bidirectional power translation circuit, a super capacitor array, an inverter circuit, a filtering and grid-connected circuit and a three-phase AC (alternating current) breaker, which are connected in sequence. The control method comprises the following steps: controlling the bidirectional power translation circuit to discharge the lithium battery pack when a power-grid side needs power compensation and the lithium battery pack is in a normal working voltage state; controlling the inverter circuit to output power needing be compensated; and controlling the bidirectional power translation circuit to charge the lithium battery pack when the power-grid side has surplus power. According to the invention, when the distribution power supply generates random power fluctuation, the surplus power is stored, and electricity is supplied to the power grid properly when the power grid needs power compensation.

appln_title: Multi-mode fault understanding and auxiliary marking method for intelligent operation and maintenance of instruments and meters
appln_abstract: The invention provides a multi-modal fault understanding and auxiliary marking method for intelligent operation and maintenance of instruments and meters, which comprises the following steps of: acquiring image, sound and text data fed back when the instruments and meters have faults, respectively preprocessing the acquired image, audio and text data, performing feature extraction on the preprocessed image data, audio data and text data, and marking the features of the preprocessed image data, audio data and text data; fusing the extracted image, audio and text features by adopting a neural network based on multi-modal quantum inspiration; training a multi-modal quantum inspiration neural network model by using the extracted image, audio and text features; loading the trained model to the rear end of an intelligent operation and maintenance platform of instruments and meters, transmitting multi-modal fault data into an API (Application Program Interface), and returning an annotation set through model reasoning; according to the method, image, voice and text features are fused through the multi-mode quantum inspiration deep network model, faults of instruments and meters are understood by fusing coding features, fault feedback information is automatically labeled, and the practicability is high.

appln_title: Kite power generating device
appln_abstract: The invention provides a kite power generating device and relates to a device for generating power through the up-down movement of a kite. The kite power generating device is composed of the kite, a kite control mechanism, a movement conversion mechanism and a generator, wherein the kite control mechanism, the movement conversion mechanism and the generator are arranged on the ground. The kite is a square plane kite composed of a skeleton and canvas, and the skeleton at the front end of the kite is a gas bag filled with helium. The kite moves up and down in a circulating mode through the movement of the kite control mechanism. The movement conversion mechanism converts the up-down movement of the kite into circumferential movement, so that the generator operates to generate the power. According to the kite power generating device, high-altitude high-speed stable airflow can be utilized for generating the power, and the wind energy utilization range is expanded; moreover, the power generating device is arranged on the ground, so that the wind energy utilization range is expanded, the investment cost and the operating cost of wind power generating are reduced, and the safety of wind power generating is improved; and in addition, the gas bag filled with the helium serves as the skeleton at the front end of the kite, and the kite can rise at any time by means of natural wind power so that various conditions can be adapted.

appln_title: Novel power system distributed collaborative quantum Q learning power generation control method
appln_abstract: The invention provides a novel power system distributed cooperation quantum Q learning power generation control method, which combines distributed cooperation, quantum and Q learning and is used for power generation control of a novel power system. Firstly, a distributed coordination method in the proposed method is used for coordination among power plants in a region; secondly, a quantum Q learning method in the method is used for formulating an optimal control strategy; and the distributed collaborative quantum Q learning power generation control method of the novel power system can solve the power generation control problem of the novel power system, realizes the intelligent power generation control function, optimizes the control strategy, and improves the control efficiency.

appln_title: Novel variable pitch decoupling structure
appln_abstract: The utility model relates to a novel variable-pitch decoupling structure which comprises a variable-pitch hydraulic cylinder, a variable-pitch shaft, a guide shaft, a main shaft, a synchronous disc and a hub. The synchronous disc is located in the hub, and a shifting fork rod in the hub penetrates through the synchronous disc. The middle of the variable-pitch shaft is arranged in a shaft hole of the guide shaft, the front end of the variable-pitch shaft is rotationally connected with the synchronous disc, and the rear end of the variable-pitch shaft is connected with a piston rod of the variable-pitch hydraulic cylinder; the outer side of the guide shaft is arranged in a shaft hole of the main shaft, and the end part of the outer side of the guide shaft is fixedly connected with the innerside of the synchronous disc through a guide shaft flange; the front end of the main shaft is fixedly connected with the hub through a main shaft flange of the main shaft. The variable-pitch shaft isreasonable in structural design, the decoupling bearing seat is directly embedded into the synchronous disc, the decoupling mode is decoupling of the synchronous disc and the main shaft, the decoupling structure is more direct, the variable-pitch shaft does not bear rotating torque and only bears axial force, the working condition of the variable-pitch shaft becomes simpler, the reaction is quicker, and variable-pitch guiding is safer and more reliable.

appln_title: Quantum migration parallel multilayer Monte Carlo doubly-fed induction generator parameter optimization method
appln_abstract: The invention provides a quantum migration parallel multilayer Monte Carlo doubly-fed induction generator parameter optimization method. The method comprises a population coding method based on quantum bit probability amplitude and a migration parallel multilayer Monte Carlo optimization method. Meanwhile, the invention provides an optimization framework of proportional integral differential parameters of a doubly-fed induction generator rotor side controller. Firstly, Monte Carlo random points are generated through a population coding method based on quantum bit probability amplitude, and thepopulation diversity can be improved under the condition that the population number is not changed; then, multiple groups of proportional integral differential parameters and fitness values reflecting the performance of the controller are obtained through the multi-layer multi-granularity parallel multi-layer Monte Carlo method; next, previous experience knowledge is learned through transfer learning, so that the optimization calculation speed is increased; and finally, proportional integral differential parameters of the doubly-fed induction generator rotor side controller with good controlperformance are obtained through the multi-layer multi-granularity parallel multi-layer Monte Carlo optimization method.

appln_title: Computer dual-fan heat radiation dust remover
appln_abstract: The invention provides a computer dual-fan heat radiation dust remover, which relates to the field of an electronic product, and solves the problems to achieve the effects of accelerated computer heat radiation and computer inside dust collection. The computer dual-fan heat radiation dust remover comprises a rubber sleeve, a heat radiation fan, an electrostatic generating board, a dust collecting fan and a purification pipeline, wherein the rubber sleeve is fixedly arranged on an end opening of an air inlet; the heat radiation fan is fixedly arranged at the air inlet part at the front end inside the purification pipeline; the electrostatic generating board is fixedly arranged at the back part of the heat radiation fan; the dust collecting fan is fixedly arranged at an air outlet end inside the purification pipeline. The computer dual-fan heat radiation dust remover has the advantages that through the rotation of the heat radiation fan, cloth is driven to generate friction with fan blades, and the effect of electrification by friction is generated; further, the electrostatic dust removal principle is utilized for collecting dust; the repeated use is realized; the energy is saved, and the pollution is avoided; the computer hardware is protected; the service life of a computer is prolonged.

appln_title: Subsynchronous oscillation relay
appln_abstract: Relay devices and methods of use for detecting and reacting to subsynchronous oscillation events in electrical energy generation and transmission systems, such as but not limited to, subsynchronous control interactions between wind-turbine generators and series-compensated transmission lines.

appln_title: Shaft coupling with protective sheath
appln_abstract: The utility model discloses a shaft coupling with protective sheath includes the intermediate casing device, and it includes an insulation support, a pair of connecting flange and a plurality of fastener, and the connecting flange sets up respectively in insulation support's both sides, radial joint insulation support of fastener and connecting flange, and wherein, each fastener includes steel bushing and fastening bolt, fastening bolt is positioned the steel bushing among insulation support and the connecting flange, and a pair of protective sheath, the protective sheath is joint in each connecting flange rotationally respectively, and wherein, the protective sheath includes a casing and multiple protection portion, and the protection part is do not followed casing interval ground and is extended to the fastener is integrative, can make the fastener be in closure state and open state, and when protection portion laminated in the fastener, the fastener was in the closure state, and when the skew fastener of protection portion, the fastener is at the state of opening.
