Quanten-Op-Codes mit Hilfe der ersten Mittel und/oder der zweiten Mittel und/oder der dritten Mittel ausführt.

appln_title: Preparing method of hybrid composite wing spar of large-scale wind power blade
appln_abstract: The invention discloses a preparing method of a hybrid composite wing spar of a large-scale wind power blade. The preparing method comprises the following steps of firstly, preprocessing a die; then, paving and covering distribution medium, demolding cloth, a perforated isolating membrane, an enhancing material performing body, the perforated isolating membrane and the demolding cloth on the surface of the die from bottom to top; paving a first ventilated felt which is provided with multiple semi-permeable ventilating connectors; forming a first layer closing die cavity by covering a first flexible vacuum bag membrane and a flexible semi-permeable membrane on the surface of the die by a sealing tape after connecting the first flexible vacuum bag membrane and the flexible semi-permeable membrane into a whole, completely sealing and coating the first flexible vacuum bag membrane and the flexible semi-permeable membrane by using a second flexible vacuum bag membrane, and forming a second layer closing die cavity; connecting the semi-permeable ventilating connectors to a vacuum pumping system and an glue injection system for injecting glue, and controlling a flow direction of matrix resin so as to realize the complete dipping in glue injection; and finally, obtaining a wing spar through solidifying, demolding and reconditioning. The preparing method disclosed by the invention has the advantages that the cost is low, the quality is stable, the technology efficiency is high, the product quality is good, and the like.

appln_title: Reinforcing structure for concrete switching section of wind turbine generator and construction method
appln_abstract: The invention discloses a reinforcing structure for a concrete switching section of a wind turbine generator and a construction method. The reinforcing structure comprises an inner steel plate, an outer steel plate, a self-locking anchor bolt group, an opposite-pulling anchor bolt group, a newly-added outer wrapping layer and a reinforcing mesh. Anchor bolt holes are reserved in the inner steel plate and the outer steel plate, studs are welded to the anchor bolt holes, the inner steel plate and the outer steel plate are arranged on the inner side of the top of a concrete tower drum and the outer sides of the concrete switching section and the top of the concrete tower drum respectively, the inner steel plate and the outer steel plate are connected with an original concrete structure through the opposite-pulling anchor bolt group and the self-locking anchor bolt group respectively, and the newly-added outer wrapping layer is filled with cementing materials and is located between the outer steel plate and the concrete switching section as well as the top of the concrete tower drum, the inner steel plate, the outer steel plate, the concrete switching section, the top of the concrete tower drum, the self-locking anchor bolt group, the opposite-pulling anchor bolt group, the reinforcing mesh and the studs are bonded, and the reinforcing mesh is arranged in the newly-added outer wrapping layer and is partially implanted into the top of the concrete switching section and the top of the concrete tower drum. The damaged concrete switching section can be effectively repaired and reinforced, so that the integrity and the bearing capacity of the structure are remarkably improved, and it is easy to construct, and the wind turbine generator encountering the extreme external load effect can rapidly recover normal operation.

appln_title: Supporting and transferring machine for wind power tower drum
appln_abstract: The utility model discloses a wind power tower supporting and transferring machine which comprises a machine body, four grooves which are correspondingly distributed are formed in the bottom of the machine body, lifting rods are movably connected into the four grooves in an inserted mode, gear columns are fixedly installed at the bottoms of the four lifting rods, and pulleys are arranged at the bottoms of the gear columns. Two correspondingly distributed rotating shaft rods are rotationally connected to the interior of the machine body, two circular gears are fixedly connected to the exteriors of the two rotating shaft rods in a sleeving mode, the circular gears are connected with teeth of the gear column in a meshed mode, first gears are fixedly installed on the exteriors of the two rotating shaft rods, and a containing plate is fixedly installed on the exterior of the machine body. Through cooperation of a lifting rod, a gear column and a circular gear, a pulley can be contracted into a groove, so that a machine body is stably placed for stably loading and unloading a tower drum, and through cooperation of a fixing plate, a clamping plate, a protection pad and a limiting bolt, the tower drum can be stably fixed to the machine body for transferring and is prevented from falling off.

appln_title: Support frame for rotary evaporato convenient to adjust
appln_abstract: The utility model discloses a support frame for rotary evaporato convenient to adjust, including installation piece, spiral shell rasp bar, solid fixed ring, connecting rod, sleeve, backup pad, worm wheel, worm, a spacing section of thick bamboo and pivot, installation piece one side is equipped with solid fixed ring, gu fixed ring outer wall fixedly connected with spiral shell rasp bar, the one end that spiral shell rasp bar kept away from solid fixed ring is passed an installation piece thread engagement and is connected with the nut, and spiral shell rasp bar is connected with the rotationof installation piece, the installation piece bottom center fixedly connected with of department connecting rod, connecting rod outside cover has the sleeve, and connecting rod and sleeve sliding connection, sleeve bottom fixedly connected with tooth wheel barrel, and sleeve and tooth wheel barrel be linked together, be equipped with the lead screw in the tooth wheel barrel, the lead screw bottomis connected with tooth wheel barrel bottom inner wall rotation through the bearing, the internal thread has been seted up to the connecting rod, and the angle of condenser pipe is conveniently adjusted to this support frame, and convenient adjustment height is simple to use, and convenient operation is fixed firm.

appln_title: Posture adjusting device and floating system thereof
appln_abstract: The invention discloses a posture adjusting device and a floating system thereof. The posture adjusting device comprises a supporting part and an adjusting part, the supporting part mainly plays a role in supporting and protecting the adjusting part, one end of the supporting part is used for being connected with a floating structure, the other end of the supporting part is a free end, the adjusting part is arranged on the supporting part, the adjusting part can swing in a preset area under the acting force provided by water flow and/or the supporting part, in the swing process of the adjusting part, the whole posture adjusting device inclines within a certain range accordingly, and under the influence of ocean storm, the whole posture adjusting device adjusts the posture of the floating structure. When the floating structure is stressed, the posture adjusting part is subjected to thrust of sea waves and acting force applied to the posture adjusting part by the floating structure, so that the posture adjusting part provides counter-acting force for adjusting postures for the floating structure to maintain the balance of the floating structure, and the floating structure floats along with the waves so as to avoid the problem that the floating structure topples over or turns over.

appln_title: BLACK START RESTORATION
appln_abstract: Embodiments herein described provide systems and techniques for performing black start operations. For example, one embodiment provides a method for performing black start operations. The method generally includes 5 operating a wind turbine in a wind park in a first mode to provide power to an alternating-current (AC) grid using a control system. The control system may include a reactive power control leg and an active power control leg. The method also includes switching operation of the wind turbine from the first mode to a second mode based on an indication to perform a black start of an electrical grid 10 and by activating a controller with an integral action to thereby increase output power of the wind turbine, the controller being coupled between the reactive power control leg and the active power control leg, and providing power to the electrical grid while operating in the second mode.

appln_title: Communication tower with preformed pile foundation
appln_abstract: The invention discloses a communication tower with a preformed pile foundation. The communication tower with the preformed pile foundation comprises a preformed pile communication tower basic part which is of a hollow structure and used as an equipment bin. The preformed pile communication tower basic part is connected with a tower body of the communication tower through a switching section, or the preformed pile communication tower basic part is directly connected with the tower body of the communication tower, and connecting flanges are respectively arranged on the upper portion of the preformed pile communication tower basic part, the upper and lower portions of the switching section, and the lower portion of the tower body of the communication tower; and the connecting flanges are mutually connected through bolts and nuts, the preformed pile communication tower basic part, the switching section, and the tower body of the communication tower are all of a hollow cylindrical structure. A lifting support is arranged on the tower body of the communication tower, the upper portion of the lifting support is connected with one end of a rope, and the rope penetrates through a pulley arranged on the top of the tower body of the communication tower; and the other end of the rope is winded on a coiling block of a winch, the winch is connected with a driving motor through a reducer, and driving mechanisms are all arranged in a cavity of the preformed pile communication tower basic part. The communication tower can achieve mass production in a factory.

appln_title: Graph-theory-based intelligent optimization method for failure recovery of smart distribution grid
appln_abstract: The invention discloses a graph-theory-based intelligent optimization method for failure recovery of a smart distribution grid. The method comprises the following steps of 1) inputting network parameters including an original structure of a distribution network, line parameters of each branch, load of each node, DG (Distributed Generation) data and other parameters; 2) inputting a number of the current faulty line and zeroing the corresponding switching state thereof; 3) setting dimensionality, iterations and corresponding parameter values of a quantum particle swarm optimization algorithm; 4) initializing a position value xk, a quantum bit, a rotation angle, a local optimal vector xp and a global optimal vector xg of each particle; 5) correcting the position value of each particle based on a graph theory; 6) updating a rotation angle guiding value, a quantum rotation angle and a bit of each quantum particle in sequence; 7) updating the position value xk of each quantum particle; 8) updating the local optimal vector and the global optimal vector of each particle; 9) carrying out convergence test; and 10) outputting an optimal particle position value x to obtain a corresponding failure recovery strategy.

appln_title: Method for making wind power bidding strategy based on predicted error
appln_abstract: The invention discloses a method for making a wind power bidding strategy based on a predicted error. The method comprises the steps of acquiring historical output data and a predicted output value ofa wind power plant, calculating the predicted error of the wind power plant, and fitting a statistical rule between the predicted error and the predicted output value; introducing bidding strategy parameters, and making a quotation form of a wind power unit; according to a supply and demand balance relationship of a power market clearing model, calculating an optimization target of the power market clearing model; calculating the total income of the wind power plant in the day-ahead and real-time markets; conducting derivation on the bidding strategy parameters by the total income of the windpower plant in the day-ahead and real-time markets to obtain a relational expression between the bidding strategy parameters of the wind power plant under an optimal bidding strategy and the predicted error; and calculating a bidding electric quantity by adopting the relational expression between the bidding strategy parameters and the predicted error so as to carry out bidding in the day-ahead market. By adopting the method provided by the invention, the optimal bidding strategy can be formulated, so that the total income of the wind power plant in the day-ahead and real-time markets is maximized.

appln_title: Optical power prediction method based on adaptive classification strategy and hybrid optimization SVR
appln_abstract: The invention provides an optical power prediction method based on an adaptive classification strategy and hybrid optimization SVR. The method comprises the following steps: S1, performing data preprocessing, i.e., eliminating abnormal samples in historical samples by adopting a dimensionless processing method and a density-based outlier algorithm, and reconstructing or directly deleting missing data by adopting an interpolation algorithm; S2, performing sample screening, i.e., screening out historical samples highly similar to the meteorological data at the prediction moment through an adaptive classification strategy; and S3, performing model training and numerical prediction, i.e., training a prediction model by adopting a quantum-behaved particle swarm algorithm and a grid method hybrid optimization SVR algorithm, and inputting meteorological data at a prediction moment to obtain a power prediction value. According to the method, adverse effects of error data and missing data on prediction precision can be reduced, historical samples highly similar to the meteorological data at the prediction moment can be screened out according to the meteorological data at the prediction moment, hyper-parameters of the SVR algorithm are optimized by adopting a quantum particle swarm and a grid method in a mixed mode, and the generalization ability of the model is improved.

appln_title: Systems and methods for post-quantum cryptography optimization
appln_abstract: Systems, apparatuses, methods, and computer program products are disclosed for post-quantum cryptography (PQC). An example method includes receiving data. The example method further includes receiving a set of data attributes about the data. The set of data attributes comprises one or more sets of data environment data attributes that are each representative of a set of data environments associated with the data. The example method further includes receiving one or more sets of data environment threat data structures associated with one or more data environments in the one or more sets of data environments associated with the data. The example method further includes selecting one or more cryptographic techniques for encrypting the data for at least the one or more data environments based on the set of data attributes, the one or more sets of data environment threat data structures, and a cryptograph optimization machine learning model.

appln_title: Systems and methods for post-quantum cryptography optimization
appln_abstract: Systems, apparatuses, methods, and computer program products are disclosed for post-quantum cryptography (PQC). An example method includes generating encrypted data. The example method further includes monitoring a set of data environments comprising the encrypted data, wherein a data environment associated with the set of data environments comprises one or more quantum computing techniques. The example method further includes generating quantum computing (QC) detection data comprising one or more instances of the one or more quantum computing techniques decrypting the encrypted data. The example method further includes, subsequent to the generation of the QC detection data, encrypting data based on the QC detection data, wherein the data is encrypted based on a set of PQC encryption attributes absent from the QC detection data.

appln_title: COMPUTATIONAL FLUID DYNAMICS SIMULATION METHOD AND APPARATUS BASED ON QUANTUM ALGORITHM, AND DEVICE
appln_abstract: A computational fluid dynamics simulation method and apparatus based on a quantum algorithm, and a device. The method comprises: in the process of using a finite volume method to analyze computational fluid dynamics, constructing, for each grid cell in a discretized numerical grid of fluid motion, a first quantum circuit that represents coordinate information of the grid cell and a second quantum circuit that represents a state parameter of the grid cell, wherein the state parameter of the grid cell is stored in a quantum random access memory, and the quantum random access memory can operate an address and data in a quantum superposition state (S11); constructing, on the basis of the first quantum circuit, the second quantum circuit and the quantum random access memory, a third quantum circuit that represents a parameter of a linear system equation of a fluid state change of the grid cell (S12); and for all the grid cells, solving the linear system equation of the grid cell on the basis of the third quantum circuit, and obtaining, when the fluid state of the grid cell tends to be stable, a fluid state as represented by a state parameter of the linear system equation of the grid cell, and taking the fluid state as a target state of the grid cell (S13). Compared with a classical algorithm, the method realizes exponential acceleration, reduces the complexity of CFD simulation and increases the practicability of CFD simulation.

appln_title: Pole climbing grappler self-adaptive to diameter change of electric pole
appln_abstract: The utility model discloses a pole climbing grappler self-adaptive to the diameter change of an electric pole, and belongs to an electric power climbing device. The device comprises a movable supporting pedal, a J-shaped hook rod and a positioning foot ring are mounted on the movable supporting pedal; the movable supporting pedal comprises a horizontal pedal supporting plate and a functional platearranged on the edge of the horizontal pedal supporting plate. The positioning foot ring is arranged on one end surface of the horizontal pedal support plate; a sliding groove is formed in the functional plate, and a tension spring sliding block is movably installed on the end face of the functional plate through the sliding groove. The straight rod end side of the J-shaped hook rod is fixed to the tension spring sliding block, and the middle of the J-shaped hook rod penetrates through the limiting block. One end of the limiting block is hinged to the horizontal pedal supporting plate; a tension spring is sleeved on the J-shaped hook rod between the limiting block and the tension spring sliding block; the climber solves the problems that the size of a steel ring is inconvenient to adjustin the pole climbing process of a traditional climber, the size of the steel ring is often not adjusted for a long time or the steel ring is jammed in the adjusting process, and therefore an operatoris prone to falling off.

appln_title: Magnetic lens for focusing a beam of charged particles
appln_abstract: The invention relates to a magnetic lens for focusing a beam of charged particles. Prior art magnetic charged particle lenses comprise a yoke and an air gap. The air gap defines the position where a magnetic field is present on the optical axis of the lens. According to the invention, a magnetic lens for focusing a beam of charged particles traveling along an optical axis comprises: - An axial bore (11) disposed around said optical axis (2), to accommodate said beam (1); - Magnetic field generating means (12), for generating a magnetic field; and - A magnetic yoke (13), to guide and concentrate said magnetic field toward said optical axis so as to form a focusing region for said beam, wherein - Said yoke has a composite structure, comprising an outer primary portion (13) and an inner secondary portion (16); - Said secondary portion is mounted as a monolithic insert within said primary portion so as to be disposed around said focusing region; - Said secondary portion comprises a waist region (15) surrounding said bore and acting as a magnetic constriction, configured such that said magnetic field undergoes saturation in said waist region, thereby causing magnetic flux to exit the waist region and form a focusing field in said focusing region. Such a waist region supplants the role of the air gap in prior-art lenses.

appln_title: Method and system for improving a policy for a stochastic control problem
appln_abstract: A method and system for improving a stochastic control problem policy, the method including a sampling device obtaining data representing sample Boltzmann machine configurations, obtaining a stochastic control problem's initialization data and initial policy; assigning representative data of initial coupler weights and node biases and the Boltzmann machine's transverse field strength to the sampling device; until a stopping criterion is met, generating a present-epoch state-action pair, amending, sampling for the present-epoch state-action pair, approximating a present-epoch state-action Q-function value, obtaining a future-epoch state-action pair through a stochastic state process including a stochastic optimization test on all state-action pairs to provide the action at the future-epoch and update the future-epoch state's policy; amending the representative data, sampling for the future-epoch state-action pair, obtaining a future-epoch state-action Q-function value, updating each weight and bias and providing the policy when the stopping criterion is met.

appln_title: Tower barrel convenient to maintain during high-place operation and operation method
appln_abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of tower barrels, and particularly relates to a tower barrel convenient to maintain during high-place operation. The tower barrel comprises a tower barrelbody, wherein a base plate is arranged on the lower portion of the tower barrel body; a supporting frame is arranged on the surface of the base plate; a butt joint groove is formed in the surface of the supporting frame; a traction rod is inserted into the butt joint groove; a damping spring is arranged between the bottom surface of the traction rod and the bottom surface of the butt joint groove;the outer side of the traction rod is sleeved with a sealing ring; and the sealing ring is fixed to the inner wall of the butt joint groove. The invention further discloses an operation method of thetower barrel convenient to maintain during high-place operation. The operation method comprises the following steps of frame climbing, lifting, overhauling work and descending. The tower barrel has the beneficial effects that an overhauling platform composed of an inner annular protection plate, an outer annular protection plate and a bearing plate is additionally arranged on the outer side of the tower barrel convenient to maintain during high-place operation, the overhauling platform is arranged around the tower barrel by one circle, and all sides of the tower barrel can be overhauled by aperson standing behind the overhauling platform and walking around the tower barrel by one circle.
